questions.question: What is the function of the structure labeled green arrow in the image?
options: Mechanical protection on the skin surface
Produces oil on the surface of the skin
Light touch receptors on the surface of the skin
UV radiation protection on the skin surface
Controls body temperature on the surface of the skin
questions.explanation: Green arrow menunjuk dermal papilla yang berisi Meissner corpuscle, reseptor light touch.

questions.question: What is the main role of ligament in joint?
questions.explanation: Ligament menghubungkan bone ke bone dan memberi structural support pada sendi. Yang menghubungkan muscle ke bone adalah tendon.

questions.question: A public health worker conducted a survey to find out the prevalence of obesity among the students in schools. What is the main goal of this survey?
options: Identifying schools that need sports programs
Reducing the amount of fast food in schools
Increases awareness about a healthy diet
questions.explanation: Survey prevalensi pada siswa dipakai untuk menilai besarnya masalah dan faktor risiko obesitas. Soal ini agak ambigu; ini jawaban yang paling mendekati.

questions.question: A 40-year-old woman came in with a complaint of joint pain involving many joints in the tissues of her hands, moving around and swelling. He also had a mild fever. What are the main causes of the above conditions?
questions.explanation: Nyeri banyak sendi tangan + demam ringan = rheumatoid arthritis, yaitu reaksi autoimmune pada jaringan sendi.

questions.question: A 50-year-old woman experienced pain and swelling in her knee joint after a fall. X-rays showed no fractures, but swelling of the soft tissues. What is the most likely diagnosis for this patient?
questions.explanation: Sprain = cedera ligament. X-ray tanpa fraktur, hanya soft tissue swelling.

questions.question: A researcher conducted a study on the relationship between smoking habits and the incidence of lung cancer. He found that smokers had a higher risk of developing lung cancer than non-smokers. What can be concluded from the results of this study?
options: Smoking has no effect on health
Lung cancer only occurs in smokers
All smokers will get lung cancer
There is a causal link between smoking and lung cancer
Non-smokers have no risk of lung cancer
questions.explanation: Perokok punya risiko lebih tinggi kanker paru, jadi ada hubungan kausal. Tidak semua perokok kena, dan non-smoker tetap berisiko.

questions.question: A 55-year-old man came in with complaints of worsening spinal pain. He had a history of smoking. What are the main causes of chronic back pain?
questions.explanation: Penyebab utama chronic back pain adalah degenerasi intervertebral disc.

questions.question: A 30-year-old woman has an itchy skin rash and red spots all over her body. He also had a fever and headache. What is the etiology of the case?
questions.explanation: Ruam gatal seluruh tubuh + demam + sakit kepala = varicella (Varicella-zoster virus).

questions.question: A 50-year-old woman has pain due to tendinitis. The doctor prescribes injectable corticosteroids. What are the potential side effects of long-term use of the drug?
questions.explanation: Corticosteroid jangka panjang menyebabkan osteoporosis (efek klasik); hipertensi dan hiperglikemia juga bisa terjadi.

questions.question: A 55-year-old man came to the clinic complaining of severe pain in his right toe, which started suddenly at night. He described a very sharp and swollen pain in the joint area, accompanied by redness and an increase in temperature around it. The patient has a history of hypertension. To avoid similar attacks in the future, what medications can patients take?
questions.explanation: Gout: Allopurinol (xanthine oxidase inhibitor) mencegah serangan berulang.

questions.question: A 55-year-old man came in with complaints of pain in the finger joints and difficulty moving. He has a history of psoriasis. What is the most likely diagnosis for this patient?
questions.explanation: Nyeri sendi jari + riwayat psoriasis = psoriatic arthritis.

questions.question: A 28-year-old pregnant woman had a mild fever and a red rash on her face. He had just interacted with the children at school. What is the etiology of the case?
questions.explanation: Ibu hamil dengan demam ringan + ruam wajah setelah kontak anak sekolah = Rubella virus.

questions.question: A 55-year-old man came in with a complaint of muscle pain after exercising. The doctor prescribes anti-inflammatory drugs. What is the most appropriate medication to reduce the symptom?
questions.explanation: NSAID untuk nyeri otot; naproxen paling sesuai. Soal punya beberapa opsi NSAID, jadi kurang tegas.

questions.question: A 45-year-old woman experienced pain and swelling in the skin in the elbow area. The results of the examination showed that there was an infection. What is the most likely diagnosis for this patient?
questions.explanation: Nyeri dan bengkak pada kulit disertai infeksi = cellulitis.

questions.question: In the process of bone remodeling, which cells are responsible for bone resorption?
questions.explanation: Osteoclast bertanggung jawab pada bone resorption saat remodeling.

questions.question: A 40-year-old man came in with complaints of white spots on his skin that were not itchy. He had just returned from a trip to the tropics. What is the etiology of the above case?
questions.explanation: Bercak putih tidak gatal setelah dari daerah tropis = pityriasis versicolor (Malassezia furfur).

questions.question: An 8-year-old child came in with a complaint of round, flesh-colored lesions on the skin that looked watery. The lesions spread in his body area. What is the etiology of the above?
questions.explanation: Lesi bulat flesh-colored pada anak, menyebar = molluscum contagiosum virus.

questions.question: A 60-year-old man with a history of diabetes and hypertension came to the hospital with a severe skin infection. Doctors recommended amputation to save his life. However, patients refuse the procedure for personal and religious reasons. What should a doctor respect in this situation?
options: Obligation to report patients to the authorities
questions.explanation: Pasien menolak amputasi karena alasan pribadi dan agama, jadi dokter harus menghormati patient autonomy.

questions.question: A 22-year-old man complained of pain in his right hand that became more painful when moved. X-rays were taken on the hands and the following images were obtained. What is the name of the process labeled number 4 on the radius bone in the image?
questions.explanation: Process pada ujung distal radius = styloid process of the radius.

questions.question: A 22-year-old man complained of pain in his right hand that became more painful when moved. X-rays were taken on the hands and the following images were obtained. What is the name of the joint labeled number 17?
questions.explanation: Label 17 tidak terbaca jelas di gambar; urutan label mengarah ke metacarpophalangeal joint. Mohon dicek dengan gambar asli.

questions.question: A 65-year-old man came in with complaints of pain and swelling in the knuckle joints. He has a history of diabetes. What is the pathophysiology of osteoarthritis?
questions.explanation: Osteoarthritis: kerusakan degeneratif joint cartilage.

questions.question: A 55-year-old man came to the clinic complaining of severe pain in his right toe, which started suddenly at night. He described a very sharp and swollen pain in the joint area, accompanied by redness and an increase in temperature around it. The patient has a history of hypertension. What substances need to be reduced in consumption to avoid these conditions?
questions.explanation: Gout: kurangi konsumsi purine.

questions.question: A public health worker wants to reduce the incidence of infectious diseases in the community. He planned a mass vaccination program. What are the indicators of the success of this program?
options: High number of people present at the vaccination event
High vaccination rates in the target population
Increased number of health workers involved
questions.explanation: Indikator keberhasilan vaksinasi massal adalah tingginya cakupan vaksinasi pada populasi target.

questions.question: A patient is given an injection into the muscle given a blue arrow below. What is the name of the muscle?
questions.explanation: Deltoid muscle, lokasi injeksi intramuscular di lengan atas.

questions.question: A 32-year-old pregnant woman was diagnosed with a rubella virus infection. The doctor explains the risks to the fetus and recommends a medical abortion. The woman felt depressed and confused about the decision to make. What should be the doctor's priority in this situation?
options: Leave the decision entirely to the patient's family
Not blaming the patient for the situation at hand
Encourage patients to make immediate decisions
Provide emotional support and clear information
Ignoring the patient's feelings and focusing on medical risks
questions.explanation: Prioritas dokter: memberi emotional support dan informasi yang jelas.

questions.question: There are proteins that bind keratinocyte cells to each other so that stability and strength are created from the epidermis. This protein is found on the surface of keratinocyte cells and is responsible for the intercellular bridge picture as shown below. What is the name of the protein in question?
questions.explanation: Desmosome mengikat keratinocyte satu sama lain (intercellular bridge).

questions.question: A doctor in a hospital wants to reduce the number of nosocomial infections. He planned a training program for medical staff on good hygiene practices. What is the main goal of this program?
options: Increase the number of medical staff
Increase the number of patients treated
questions.explanation: Pelatihan hygiene bertujuan meningkatkan awareness pencegahan infeksi.

questions.question: A 35-year-old man came in with complaints of itching and a red rash between the fingers. He had just returned from the coastal area. What is the etiology of the above case?
questions.explanation: Gatal + ruam di sela jari = scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei).

questions.question: When muscles relax, there is a protein that prevents the interaction between myosin and actin. What is the name of the protein?
questions.explanation: Saat relaksasi, tropomyosin menutup myosin-binding site pada actin.

questions.question: What cells play a role in the bone resorption process?
questions.explanation: Osteoclast berperan pada bone resorption.

questions.question: A 60-year-old man with a history of gout came with an attack of severe pain in his toes. The doctor prescribes allopurinol. What is the mechanism of the drug given?
questions.explanation: Allopurinol menghambat xanthine oxidase sehingga produksi uric acid turun.

questions.question: What is Haversian canal?
options: Channels in the bones that contain blood vessels and nerves
Structures that store fat in bones
Connective tissue that connects bones with muscles
The space inside the bone that contains the bone marrow
questions.explanation: Haversian canal adalah saluran pada cortical bone yang berisi blood vessels dan nerves.

questions.question: A 70-year-old man came in with complaints of pain in the finger joints and difficulty moving. The results of the examination showed that there was a depletion of cartilage. What is the most likely diagnosis for this patient?
questions.explanation: Lansia dengan nyeri sendi jari dan cartilage menipis = osteoarthritis.

questions.question: A 70-year-old man with osteoporosis had a fracture. The doctor prescribes bisphosphonates. What is the mechanism of action of the prescribed treatment?
questions.explanation: Bisphosphonates menghambat bone resorption oleh osteoclast.

questions.question: A 50-year-old woman came with complaints of itching and a red rash in the genital area. He had just returned from a trip to the tropics. What is the etiology of the above case?
questions.explanation: Gatal dan ruam merah di area genital = candidiasis (Candida albicans).

questions.question: A 25-year-old woman came in with complaints of itching on the scalp and the presence of lice. What is the etiology of the case?
questions.explanation: Gatal di scalp dengan lice = Pediculus humanus capitis.

questions.question: A 10-year-old child came to the hospital after falling while riding a bicycle. He complained of severe pain in his right knee and difficulty walking. On physical examination, swelling in the distal tibia area and pain during palpation were seen. X-rays show the presence of a fracture classified as Salter-Harris as shown in the following image. What anatomical structures are involved and indicated by the blue arrow in the image above?
questions.explanation: Blue arrow menunjuk physis (epiphyseal plate), tempat terjadinya Salter-Harris fracture.

questions.question: What are the main functions of chondrocyte cells in cartilage?
questions.explanation: Chondrocyte memproduksi extracellular matrix (collagen type II dan proteoglycan).

questions.question: A 28-year-old woman was diagnosed with severe psoriasis. Doctors recommend expensive biological therapies, but patients do not have health insurance. The patient asked the doctor to give her the drug for free. What should be the doctor's main consideration in this situation?
options: Fairness in the distribution of health resources
Obligation to provide the treatment desired by the patient
Obligation to reduce the cost of care
questions.explanation: Sumber daya terbatas: pertimbangan utama adalah justice (fairness dalam distribusi sumber daya kesehatan).

questions.question: A 35-year-old woman has atopic dermatitis. The doctor prescribes antihistamine. What is the purpose of the prescribed drug?
questions.explanation: Antihistamine mengurangi itching.

questions.question: A 28-year-old man came to the emergency department after sustaining an injury while playing basketball. While jumping, he felt a loud "pop" sound on the back of his right leg, followed by a sharp pain. He immediately fell and could not stand or walk normally. On physical examination, swelling was seen in the Achilles tendon area, and when palpation was performed, there was significant pain. He also had difficulty performing dorsiflexion movements on the ankle. This symptom indicates the possible rupture of the Achilles tendon. Anatomically, what muscles does the Achilles tendon connect the Calcaneus bone with?
questions.explanation: Achilles tendon menghubungkan calcaneus dengan gastrocnemius (dan soleus).

questions.question: A 60-year-old man came in with complaints of wounds in his leg that did not heal. He has a history of travel to the tropics. What is the etiology of the above case?
questions.explanation: Luka kronis tidak sembuh + riwayat ke daerah tropis mengarah ke Strongyloides stercoralis. Jawaban paling mungkin dari opsi.

questions.question: A 45-year-old woman has low back pain due to a herniated disc. The doctor prescribes muscle relaxants. What medications may be prescribed?
questions.explanation: Baclofen adalah muscle relaxant.

questions.question: An epidemiologist is conducting research on the spread of influenza virus infection in the community. He collects data on the number of cases, age, and location. What is the most appropriate type of study to use in this study?
questions.explanation: Mengumpulkan jumlah kasus, usia, dan lokasi pada satu waktu = cross-sectional (descriptive) study.

questions.question: A 4-year-old child came with complaints of itching and a red rash on the skin. He had just been playing in the park and was exposed to the ground. What is the etiology of the above case?
questions.explanation: Anak terpapar tanah + ruam gatal = cutaneous larva migrans (Ancylostoma braziliense).

questions.question: A 16-year-old teenager came to the clinic complaining of a small, hard and rough lump on the palm of his hand. The lump is painless and looks like a wart. What is the etiology of the case?
questions.explanation: Benjolan keras kasar seperti wart di telapak tangan = Human papillomavirus.

questions.question: What is the name of the structure labeled with the green arrow in the image?
questions.explanation: Green arrow menunjuk Meissner corpuscle di dermal papilla.

questions.question: A 30-year-old woman has joint pain due to rheumatoid arthritis. The doctor prescribes methotrexate. What is the mechanism of action of the drug for this patient?
questions.explanation: Methotrexate menghambat cell proliferation (DHFR inhibitor).

questions.question: Antigen presenting cells (APCs) function to capture, process, and present antigens to T cells in the immune system. What is the name of the antigen presenting cell found in the epidermis of the skin?
questions.explanation: Langerhans cells adalah antigen presenting cells di epidermis.

questions.question: A 30-year-old woman developed a red and itchy rash in the elbow and knee area. He had a history of allergies. What are the main causes of allergic reactions to the skin?
questions.explanation: Reaksi alergi kulit terjadi lewat histamine release dari mast cell.

questions.question: A 65-year-old man with a history of diabetes came with complaints of pain and swelling in the legs. The results of the examination showed the presence of ulcers. What is the most likely diagnosis for this patient?
questions.explanation: Pasien diabetes dengan ulcer di kaki = diabetic ulcer.

questions.question: A 16-year-old teenager came in with severe acne complaints. The doctor prescribes isotretinoin. What are the main concerns when using the prescribed treatment?
questions.explanation: Isotretinoin bersifat teratogenik: risk of fetal malformations.

questions.question: A 40-year-old woman suffers from dry and scaly skin. The doctor prescribes an emollient cream. What is the main function of the prescribed treatment?
questions.explanation: Emollient melembabkan kulit.

questions.question: A 5-year-old child came in with complaints of high fever, cough, and a red rash that spread from the face to the rest of the body. What is the etiology of the case?
questions.explanation: Demam tinggi, batuk, ruam menyebar dari wajah ke seluruh tubuh = Measles virus.

questions.question: A 35-year-old woman developed a red and itchy rash on her skin. The doctor diagnoses allergic dermatitis and prescribes corticosteroid creams. What is the main function of the treatment given?
questions.explanation: Corticosteroid topikal mengurangi inflammation.

questions.question: A 65-year-old man with chronic joint pain was diagnosed with osteoarthritis. The doctor prescribes glucosamine supplements. What is the most likely purpose of using the supplements?
questions.explanation: Glucosamine mendukung cartilage health.

questions.question: A 3-year-old child came in with complaints of fever, lesions in the mouth, and rashes on the hands and feet. What is the etiology of the case?
questions.explanation: Demam, lesi di mulut, ruam tangan dan kaki = hand-foot-and-mouth disease (Coxsackievirus).

questions.question: What is the name of the structure labeled with the blue arrow in the image?
questions.explanation: Blue arrow menunjuk lapisan gelap berisi keratohyalin granules = stratum granulosum.

questions.question: What is the physiological function of the antigen presenting cells?
options: Produces proteins that provide strength and mechanical protection from friction on the skin
Produces pigments that give color to the skin and protect against damage caused by ultraviolet (UV) rays
Captures, processes, and presents certain substances to T lymphocytes in the immune system
Stores energy, provides insulation, and protects the tissues under the skin
Touch receptors and provide information about texture and pressure on the skin
questions.explanation: Antigen presenting cells menangkap, memproses, dan mempresentasikan antigen ke T lymphocytes.

questions.question: A 10-year-old child came to the hospital after falling while riding a bicycle. He complained of severe pain in his right knee and difficulty walking. On physical examination, swelling in the distal tibia area and pain during palpation were seen. X-rays show the presence of a fracture classified as Salter-Harris as shown in the following image. What are the physiological processes found in the anatomical structures shown by the blue arrows?
questions.explanation: Physis (growth plate) = tempat endochondral ossification.

questions.question: What are the characteristics of type II muscle fibers?
options: More resistant to fatigue than type I
Contracts faster but gets tired more easily
questions.explanation: Type II muscle fibers berkontraksi lebih cepat tetapi lebih mudah lelah.

questions.question: What is the function of sarcoplasmic reticulum in muscle cells?
options: Stores and releases calcium ions for muscle contraction
Produces proteins for muscle cell maintenance
Produces energy in the form of ATP
questions.explanation: Sarcoplasmic reticulum menyimpan dan melepaskan Ca2+ untuk kontraksi otot.

questions.question: An epidemiologist found that there was an increase in cases of skin diseases in certain areas. He conducted an analysis to determine the environmental factors that contributed. What is the first step in this epidemiological analysis?
questions.explanation: Langkah pertama analisis epidemiologi: identify the affected population.

questions.question: A 60-year-old woman experienced persistent back pain and difficulty moving. He had a history of osteoporosis. What are the main pathomechanisms of osteoporosis?
questions.explanation: Osteoporosis: penurunan bone mineral density.

questions.question: A 15-year-old teenage girl came to the clinic with complaints of severe acne. She asked the doctor to prescribe isotretinoin, but her parents refused because they were worried about the side effects. What should be the doctor's approach in this situation?
options: Leave the decision entirely to the parents
Discuss risks and benefits with patient and parents
Ignore parents' concerns and prescribe medications
Excluding the patient for making decision
questions.explanation: Pendekatan terbaik: diskusikan risiko dan manfaat bersama pasien dan orang tua.

questions.question: A 50-year-old man came in with complaints of redness, swelling, and pain in the skin in the leg area. He has a history of diabetes. What is the etiology of the above case?
questions.explanation: Cellulitis pada pasien diabetes paling sering oleh Streptococcus pyogenes (S. aureus juga mungkin). Soal ini kurang tegas.

questions.question: What are the main causes of pain in piriformis syndrome?
questions.explanation: Piriformis syndrome: nyeri akibat sciatic nerve compression.

questions.question: A 16-year-old teenager came in with complaints of pain and swelling in his wrist after falling off a bicycle. What happens to bone tissue after a fracture?
options: Decreased blood flow to the fracture area
The healing process through the formation of the callus
questions.explanation: Setelah fraktur, penyembuhan lewat pembentukan callus.

questions.question: A 55-year-old man came to the clinic with complaints of joint pain that worsened in the morning and stiffness that lasted more than an hour. The results of the physical examination showed swelling in the small joints. What is the most likely diagnosis for this patient?
questions.explanation: Nyeri sendi kecil, morning stiffness lebih dari 1 jam = rheumatoid arthritis.

questions.question: A doctor at a public health clinic wants to raise awareness about the importance of vaccination in children. He plans an educational campaign for parents. What should be the focus of this campaign?
options: Increase the number of doctors administering vaccines
Concealing the facts regarding vaccines' side effects
Increase knowledge about the benefits of vaccination
Increase the number of vaccines available
questions.explanation: Fokus kampanye edukasi adalah meningkatkan pengetahuan tentang manfaat vaksinasi.

questions.question: A 40-year-old woman came to the clinic for a routine health check-up. Doctors recommend cholesterol and blood pressure screening. What is the purpose of this primary prevention?
options: Reducing the number of patients in hospitals
questions.explanation: Screening kolesterol dan tekanan darah bertujuan early detection penyakit.

questions.question: A 6-year-old child came in with complaints of fever, sore throat, and a red rash all over his body. She had just interacted with her friends who were also experiencing similar symptoms. What is the etiology of the case?
questions.explanation: Demam, sore throat, ruam seluruh tubuh pada anak = scarlet fever (Streptococcus pyogenes).
